# x402 adapter fixtures

**Constructed, not recorded.** No payment was made. Every file here is
generated by `../fixture_test.go` (`go test ./adapter/x402 -run
TestFixturesUpToDate -update`), and the test requires the committed files to be
byte-identical to the generator's output.

Signing keys: the published default development accounts #0 (payer,
`0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266`) and #1 (payee and receipt signer,
`0x70997970C51812dc3A010C7d01b50e0d17dc79C8`) of the Hardhat Network and
Foundry Anvil local chains. They are derived from the public mnemonic
`test test test test test test test test test test test junk` and listed in
both tools' documentation. Anyone can sign with them, so nothing signed by them
proves anything about a real party.

The chain and token are Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`) USDC
(`0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e`, EIP-712 name `USDC`, version
`2`). The transaction hash is made up.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `exchange-positive.http` | header block: `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` and `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` (with a v1 receipt) |
| `payment-payload.json` | the bare payment payload octets (base64-decoded `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`) |
| `leg-payer-observed.json` | a settlement-records `payer_observed` leg wrapping `x402.payment-payload`, `x402.settle-response` and `x402.receipt`; the Capsule envelope is omitted |
| `*-signature-bit-flip.*` | the same with one byte of the payer's signature changed (in the leg, `digest` recomputed) |
| `trust-policy.json` | the default policy: payer accounts `eoa-or-contract`, offline |
| `trust-policy-eoa.json` | the same with `x402.payer_accounts` `eoa`: the policy for the negative fixtures |
| `trust-policy-recorded-lookup.json` | the default policy with a constructed transaction lookup under `recorded` |
